rules.title: Feature Should Express a Clear Job to Be Done
rules.summary: Enhancement specs and route entry points should make the user task explicit rather than centring internal system activity.
signals: spec is dominated by internal system language
route offers system mechanics without user task framing
screen language does not reveal the intended user outcome

rules.title: Actions Should Align to User Outcome
rules.summary: Primary actions should read like steps toward a user outcome rather than exposing raw implementation mechanics.
signals: action labels expose internal pipeline mechanics
screen actions optimise for system maintenance instead of user task completion
actions read like engineering verbs rather than product verbs

rules.title: Terminology Should Stay User-Facing and Consistent
rules.summary: Visible route and action language should prefer stable product terminology over internal architecture terms.
signals: internal architecture terms in headings or actions
visible labels conflict with product language in the spec

patterns.title: Task Outcome Template
patterns.summary: State the user role, the task they need to complete, and the outcome they should achieve before describing internal mechanics.

patterns.title: Review Objective Template
patterns.summary: Use user-facing review verbs and outcome language in headings and actions so screens read like product tasks rather than internal consoles.
